title: Core Application Overview
summary: The `core_application` module serves as the central orchestrator for the Ollama application, integrating user entry points, server infrastructure, configuration management, and data storage. It ensures a cohesive and functional system by coordinating these fundamental components.

nodes.label: User Interface & CLI
nodes.title: User Interaction Front-end
nodes.description: Represents the various ways users interact with the Ollama application, including the desktop GUI and command-line interface.

nodes.label: Application Entry Points
nodes.title: Application Startup & Launch
nodes.description: This module defines how the application starts, whether through the desktop GUI, CLI, or specialized tools, orchestrating initial setup and server startup.

nodes.label: Server Infrastructure
nodes.title: Core Server & API Services
nodes.description: Manages the central API server, UI serving, process lifecycle, and handles incoming requests for model interaction and data retrieval.

nodes.label: Configuration & Utilities
nodes.title: App Settings & System Utilities
nodes.description: Provides essential services for managing application configuration, logging, safe file operations, and software updates.

nodes.label: Data & Storage
nodes.title: Persistent Data Management
nodes.description: Handles the storage and retrieval of persistent application data, user settings, chat history, and caching of AI model artifacts.

nodes.label: Operating System Services
nodes.title: System-Level Interactions
nodes.description: Represents the underlying operating system providing file system access, process management, and system signals to the application.

groups.label: User Interaction Layer
groups.title: User-Facing Components
groups.description: Components that directly interact with the user or initiate application processes.

groups.label: Core Application Logic
groups.title: Central Processing & Management
groups.description: The central modules responsible for the application's main functionality, including server operations, configuration, and data handling.

groups.label: System Environment
groups.title: External System Dependencies
groups.description: External operating system services and resources that the application relies upon for its operations.
